task.classification.explain: Predicts a category for each row, such as a species or yes / no.
task.regression.explain: Predicts a number for each row, such as a price or a temperature.
rating.note.no_metric: The score needed for the rating is missing, so the rating is the lowest.
rating.note.single_class: The training data had only one class, so there was nothing to learn.
rating.note.constant_target: The column to predict had the same value in every row, so there was nothing to learn.
rating.how_text: Fione tests the model on rows it did not learn from (cross-validation) and compares it with a simple guess.
rating.how_classification: For categories, the simple guess always picks the most common one. The rating shows how much of the remaining room to a perfect score the model covers: (accuracy - share of the most common category) / (1 - that share).
rating.how_regression: For numbers, the simple guess is always the average. The rating is 1 - (typical error of the model / typical error of the average), where the typical error is the root mean squared error.
rating.how_bands: This gives a score from 0 to 1: below 0.2 is 1 star, then one more star at 0.2, 0.4, 0.6 and 0.8. A model whose training hit an error gets at most 2 stars.

upload.title: Upload training data
upload.lead: Fione learns from examples. Upload a CSV file with one example per row and a header row with the column names.
upload.guide: Include the column you want to predict, for example the species of a flower or the price of a house, plus the columns that may help predict it.
upload.rule_format: CSV only. Columns may be separated by commas, semicolons, tabs or |.
upload.rule_encoding: Text encodings: UTF-8, Shift_JIS or EUC-JP.
upload.rule_header: The first row must hold the column names.
upload.error.form: The upload did not arrive in one piece. Choose the file again and retry.
upload.error.missing: Choose a CSV file to upload.
upload.error.too_large: The file is larger than the upload limit. Remove some rows or columns, or ask an administrator to raise the limit.
upload.error.encoding: Fione could not read the text of this file. Save it as CSV in UTF-8 (or Shift_JIS) and try again. Excel files must be saved as CSV first.
upload.error.empty: The file is empty. Choose a CSV file that has data.
upload.error.no_rows: The file has column names but no data rows. Add rows below the header and try again.
upload.error.parse: Fione could not read the file as CSV. Check that every row has the same number of columns as the header.
upload.error.invalid: Fione could not use this file. Check that it is a CSV file and try again.
analysis.title: Data analysis
analysis.lead: Tell Fione what to predict in “{name}” and which columns to learn from.
analysis.sampled: Column details are based on the first {n} rows.
analysis.target: What do you want to predict?
analysis.target_hint: The model learns to fill in this column for new rows.
analysis.detected.classification: “{name}” holds {values} different values, so Fione suggests classification: predicting which value each row has.
analysis.detected.regression: “{name}” holds numbers with many different values, so Fione suggests regression: predicting a number for each row.
analysis.warn.not_train: This is not training data, so it cannot be used to train a model.
analysis.warn.one_column: The data has only one column. Add columns the model can learn from.
analysis.warn.target_id: The column to predict looks like an ID (every value is different). Check that this is the column you want.
analysis.warn.leaks: {n} columns might give the answer away (they match the column to predict too closely). They are unchecked below.
analysis.warn.leak_scores: {n} columns predict the answer suspiciously well on their own. They stay checked: make sure each one is known at prediction time.
analysis.warn.leak_partial: Fione ran out of time while checking which columns predict the answer on their own, so some columns were not checked.
analysis.error.summary: Please check the following, then run again:
analysis.error.target: Choose a column to predict from the list.
analysis.error.inputs_unknown: Some selected input columns are not in this data. Reload the page and choose again.
analysis.error.inputs_empty: Choose at least one input column for the model to learn from.
analysis.error.runtime: Enter the maximum run time as a whole number of minutes, 1 or more.
analysis.error.config: Fione could not start training with these settings.
analysis.inputs: Which columns should the model learn from?
analysis.inputs_hint: Checked columns are the inputs. Fione has unchecked columns that would not help, with the reason shown.
analysis.col.name: Column
analysis.reason.id: Looks like an ID: every value is different, so it cannot help predict.
analysis.reason.constant: Has the same value in every row, so it cannot help predict.
analysis.reason.leak_identical: Is identical to the column to predict: it would give the answer away.
analysis.reason.leak_correlated: Moves almost exactly with the column to predict. It may give the answer away: check that it is known at prediction time.
analysis.reason.leak_determines: Each of its values always comes with the same answer: it may give the answer away.
analysis.reason.leak_predicts_alone: Predicts the answer suspiciously well on its own. It may give the answer away: check that it is known at prediction time.
analysis.reason.leak_ordered: Its values, or where they are missing, follow the answer. An ID or a date can do this when rows were added in order of the answer, and so can a time that is filled in only for some answers. It may give the answer away: check that it is known at prediction time.
analysis.kind_note: Kind is what Fione detected each column holds.
analysis.task_hint: Fione suggests one from the column to predict. Change it only if the suggestion is wrong.
analysis.runtime_hint: Training stops when this time is up and keeps the best model found. Longer runs can find better models.
analysis.runtime_custom_label: Other maximum run time, in minutes
analysis.what_text: Fione trains several kinds of models on your {rows} rows, checks each on rows it did not learn from, and keeps the best one, or a blend of the best ones.
analysis.what_background: Training runs on the server: you can leave this page and come back later.
analysis.viewer_note: You have view-only access, so you cannot start training. Ask the project owner for edit access.

job.lead.batch_predict: Fione is running your data through the model. This page updates by itself.
job.best_hint: The error is measured on rows the models did not learn from: lower is better.
job.stage.queued: Waiting to start. Training begins as soon as the server is free.

job.cancel_effect.automl: Training stops and no model is saved. You can run it again later.

summary.title: Prediction summary
summary.score.accuracy: On rows it did not learn from, the model was right about {pct}% of the time. Always guessing the most common answer would be right {base}% of the time.
summary.score.auc: On rows it did not learn from, the model told the two classes apart with an AUC of {auc} (0.5 is guessing, 1 is perfect).
summary.score.rmse: On rows it did not learn from, the model's predictions were typically off by about {error}. Always guessing the average would be off by about {spread}.
summary.score.r2: On rows it did not learn from, the model explained about {pct}% of the variation in the values.
summary.degraded: Training hit an error and kept the best model it had by then. The model works, but may be weaker than usual. Running again may help.
summary.ensemble_hint: A blend averages the predictions of several models, which is often more accurate than any one of them.
summary.top_inputs_hint: The columns the model relied on most, as a share of all it used.
summary.predict_text: Upload a CSV with the same input columns and download the predictions.
summary.predict_viewer: You have view-only access, so you cannot make predictions.
summary.serving_title: Serve it from your own system
summary.serving_text: Download the serving bundle, unzip it and start it with Docker to get predictions over HTTP.
summary.serving_run: Then run this where you unzipped it:
summary.serving_unavailable: The serving bundle is not available for this model. Ask an administrator to check the serving image settings.

predict.lead: Upload data and “{name}” will predict {target} for every row.
predict.error.model: The model file is missing or damaged, so it cannot predict. Train the model again.
predict.error.missing: The file is missing {n} columns the model needs:
predict.error.missing_hint: Add these columns (with the same names) and upload the file again.
predict.needs_hint: Other columns are fine: they are ignored by the model, and you can keep them in the result. {target} itself is not needed.
predict.error.run: Fione could not start the prediction.
predict.ready: “{name}” ({rows} rows) has every column the model needs. Choose what to put in the result.
predict.extra: {n} columns are not used by the model. You can still keep them in the result.
predict.output_hint: The prediction is always included. Checked columns from your file are copied next to it.
predict.columns_explain: “predict” is the prediction. For categories, each “p_” column is the probability of that category.
predict.contributions_hint: Slower. Adds a “contrib_” column per model input: how much it moved the row’s prediction. With “contrib_bias”, the average prediction, they add up to the predicted value, or for categories to the probability of the predicted category (with two categories, of the last “p_” column). Up to 100,000 rows.

result.guide: Here are your predictions! Download the CSV to use them in a spreadsheet or another system.
result.columns_explain: “predict” is the prediction. For categories, each “p_” column is the probability of that category.
analysis.target_error.few_rows: Training needs at least {min} rows, and this data has {n}. Add more rows.
analysis.target_error.missing: The column to predict is empty in {n} rows. Training refuses it: fill in or remove those rows, or choose another column.
analysis.target_error.single_value: The column to predict has the same value in every row, so there is nothing to predict. Choose another column.

analysis.target_error.infinite: The column to predict holds infinite values. Replace or remove them, then try again.

column.is_target: This is the column Fione would predict by default.
column.leak: This column might give away “{target}”, the column to predict:
column.leak_score: On its own, this column predicts “{target}”, the column to predict, with a score of {score} (1 is perfect):

train.title: Training settings
train.lead: Every training setting for “{name}”. The defaults are the engine's own; change only what you need.
train.h.task: Automatic decides from the column to predict (now: {detected}). Binary or multiclass follows from the number of classes.
train.h.inputs: Checked columns are learned from. Columns that would not help are unchecked, with the reason.
train.h.max_runtime_minutes: Training stops at this time and keeps the best model so far. Whole minutes, 1 or more.
train.h.max_runtime_secs_per_model: Caps each model's training. Empty: no cap.
train.h.max_models: Stops after this many models have been tried. Empty: no limit.
train.h.nfolds: Each model is checked on this many parts of the data it did not learn from. 2 or more.
train.h.seed: The same seed gives the same splits and search. 0 to 4294967295.
train.h.balance_classes: Gives rare classes more weight while learning.
train.h.stopping_rounds: A model family stops when this many tries in a row do not improve. 0: never stop early.
train.h.stopping_metric: The score that decides whether a try improved.
train.h.stopping_tolerance: How much better a try must be to count as an improvement (a share, such as 0.001).
train.h.sort_metric: The score the models are ranked by in the leaderboard.
train.h.keep_cv_predictions: Keeps each row's prediction from the model that did not learn from it.
train.h.keep_cv_models: Keeps the models of each fold. This makes the model file much larger.
train.h.keep_cv_fold_assignment: Keeps which part each row was in.
train.error.unknown_field: The form held a field it should not have. Reload the page and try again.
train.error.duplicate_field: The form held a setting twice. Reload the page and try again.
train.error.whole_optional: Enter a whole number of 1 or more, or leave it empty.
train.error.nfolds: Enter a whole number of 2 or more.
train.error.seed: Enter a whole number from 0 to 4294967295.
train.error.whole_zero: Enter a whole number of 0 or more.
train.error.tolerance: Enter a number of 0 or more, such as 0.001.
train.error.metric: This metric does not fit the prediction type. Choose one listed for it, or Automatic.
train.error.config: Training cannot start with these settings.

jobs.delete_finished_effect: Their logs go too. Models and predictions they made are kept. Running and waiting jobs stay.
jobs.error.not_finished: Only a finished job can be deleted. Stop it first.
error.form: The form could not be read. Reload the page and try again.
jobs.gone_hint: This list can no longer be shown here. The project may have been deleted, or your access to it changed.
jobs.reload_hint: The latest list could not be loaded. Reload the page to see it.

job.lead.module: Fione is running the module on your data. This page updates by itself.

job.cancel_effect.module: The module stops and no result is saved.
mode.label: View
mode.hint: Detailed shows every screen and setting. It only changes what you see, not what you may do.
metric.accuracy.explain: Share of rows predicted right. Higher is better.
metric.logloss.explain: How far the predicted probabilities are from the answers. Lower is better.
metric.auc.explain: How well the two classes are told apart: 0.5 is guessing, 1 is perfect.
metric.rmse.explain: Typical size of the error, in the column's own units. Lower is better.
metric.mae.explain: Average size of the error, in the column's own units. Lower is better.
metric.r2.explain: Share of the variation explained: 1 is perfect, 0 is no better than the average.
models.title: Models
models.lead: Every model trained or imported in this project.
models.order_note: Models are ranked by their rating (how much better than a simple guess they are), then the newest first: their own scores use different measures.
models.col.name: Model
models.delete_effect: It can no longer predict. Predictions already made are kept. A prediction still waiting for it will fail.
models.compare.classification: Accuracy of the {n} best-rated classification models
models.compare.regression: RMSE of the {n} best-rated regression models (lower is better)
models.export_all_hint: Packs every model of this project into one zip that another Fione can import. Only the latest export is kept.
models.export.busy: An export of this project is already running. Wait for it to finish.
models.error.export: The model's files are missing, so it cannot be exported.
model.untrusted: This model was imported from another installation and trusted by an administrator: its signature was not made here.
model.rating_rule: The rating compares the model, on rows it did not learn from, with always making the simplest guess (the most common answer, or the average).
model.board_hint: One row per algorithm tried, best first, scored by {metric} on rows the models did not learn from. The ensemble blends the members with a weight.
model.board_note: Only the algorithms with a weight above 0 are in the final model.
model.history.hint: Each point is one try, in the order they ran; the dashed line is the best so far. The score is the search loss (log loss or RMSE): lower is better.
model.importance.chart: The {n} inputs the model relied on most
model.metrics_note: Measured on rows the models did not learn from (cross-validation), for the final blend.
model.diagnostics_missing: No confusion matrix, per-class figures or residual charts are stored with this model. Models trained before Fione kept them do not have them, nor do models whose diagnostics could not be computed or stored.
model.diag.unreadable: The diagnostics stored with this model cannot be read, so they are not shown.
model.diag.partial: Part of the diagnostics stored with this model could not be read and is left out.
model.diag.rows: From the cross-validation predictions of {n} training rows.
model.diag.sampled: From the cross-validation predictions of a random sample of {n} training rows.
model.diag.confusion_hint: Rows are the actual classes, columns the predicted ones. Each cell gives the number of rows and their share of the actual class; the more strongly a cell stands out, the larger the share.
model.diag.confusion_caption: Confusion matrix: rows actual class, columns predicted class
model.diag.other_note: Only the 30 largest classes have their own row and column; the rest are counted together as “Other classes”.
model.diag.per_class_hint: Precision: of the rows predicted as the class, the share that were. Recall: of the rows of the class, the share found. F1 combines the two. “—” means undefined, such as the precision of a class never predicted.
model.diag.per_class_truncated: Only the {n} largest classes are listed.
model.diag.roc_hint: How well the model ranks “{positive}” rows above the others, over every threshold. The dashed diagonal is guessing; the nearer the curve comes to the top left, the better. Area under the curve: {auc}.
model.diag.roc_chart: ROC curve for “{positive}”: true positive rate against false positive rate
model.diag.pr_hint: Over every threshold: the share of “{positive}” predictions that are right (precision) against the share of “{positive}” rows found (recall).
model.diag.calibration_hint: The rows grouped into 10 bins by their predicted probability of “{positive}”: a well-calibrated model stays near the dashed diagonal.
model.diag.calibration_chart: Observed share of “{positive}” against the predicted probability, in {n} bins
model.diag.residual_hint: Residual = actual − predicted: a positive residual means the model predicted too low.
model.diag.residual_chart: Rows by residual (actual − predicted), in {n} bins
model.diag.scatter_hint: Each point is one training row's cross-validation prediction. The points are a random sample of up to 2,000 rows, in random order; a point on the dashed diagonal was predicted exactly.
model.diag.scatter_chart: Predicted against actual value for a random sample of {n} rows (at most 2,000), in random order
model.diag.deciles: Mean residual in each tenth of the training rows, ordered by predicted value
import.title: Import a model
import.lead: Add a model exported from Fione (a zip) to this project.
import.warning: A model file can run code on the server when it is loaded. Fione only loads models whose signature was made by this installation, unless you choose to trust a foreign one below.
import.file_hint: A zip made by Export on a model page, up to {mb} MB.
import.trust: Trust a model from another Fione installation
import.trust_hint: Only if you know where the file comes from: Fione cannot check that its code is safe, and loading it may run that code on this server. The model is marked as imported and unverified.
import.error.too_large: The file is larger than a model export may be.
import.error.missing: Choose the zip file to import.
import.error.untrusted: The model's signature was not made by this installation (or the file was changed). If you know where it comes from, tick “Trust a model from another Fione installation” and import it again.
import.error.invalid: This file is not a model export Fione can import.
modules.title: Python modules
modules.lead: Data operations and models that jobs can run on a dataset: the built-in ones and those uploaded by administrators.
modules.upload_lead: A module is one Python file that defines MODULE and run(df, params, ctx).
modules.warning: They run in the job workers with the same privileges as Fione itself: they can read its secret key, its environment and every project's data. Upload only code you have read and trust. Uploading is for administrators only.
modules.col.name: Name
modules.delete_effect: States it trained are deleted too. Jobs already finished keep their results.
modules.run_note: Modules are run as jobs through the API (POST /api/v1/projects/{project}/jobs/module).
modules.id_hint: Lower-case letters, digits and _, starting with a letter; up to 40 characters.
modules.acknowledge: I understand that this code will run unsandboxed with Fione's privileges, and I trust it.
modules.error.acknowledge: Tick the box to confirm you trust this code before uploading it.
modules.error.file: Choose the Python file to upload.
modules.error.refused: The module could not be added.
account.title: Account
account.lead: Your sign-in details, your password and the API tokens that act as you.
account.done.password: Your password was changed. Other devices have to sign in again.
account.done.revoked: The token was revoked. It no longer works.
account.role.admin: Sees and manages every project, and manages users, Python modules and model imports.
account.role.editor: Creates projects, and uploads data, trains models and predicts in the projects they own or may edit.
account.role.viewer: Looks at the projects shared with them, without changing anything.
account.roles_note: An administrator sets your role. A project's owner decides who else may see or edit it.
account.password_lead: After the change you stay signed in here; everywhere else you have to sign in again. API tokens keep working.
account.error.current_wrong: The current password is not correct.
account.error.new_length: The new password needs at least {n} characters.
account.error.confirm: The two new passwords do not match.
account.error.token_name: Give the token a name of 1 to {n} characters.
account.tokens_lead: A token lets a script use the API as you: with your role and your projects. Anyone who has it can do what you can, so keep it secret and revoke it when it is no longer needed.
account.token_name_hint: Say what will use it, for example “nightly report”.
account.col.name: Name
account.revoke_effect: Scripts that use it stop working at once. This cannot be undone.
account.tokens_unrecorded: Fione does not record when a token was last used.
secret.once: Copy it now: it is shown only this once.
secret.label: Token
secret.keep: Fione keeps only a fingerprint of it and cannot show it again. If you lose it, revoke it and create a new one.
users.title: Users
users.lead: Everyone who can sign in to Fione, and their role.
users.done.created: The user was created. Give them their username and password.
users.done.role: The role was changed. It applies from their next request.
users.done.password: The new password was set. The user has to sign in again.
users.username_hint: Letters, digits, dot, hyphen and underscore; up to 64.
users.password_hint: At least {n} characters. They can change it on their account page.
users.reset_effect: Their sessions end and they sign in with the new one. Their API tokens keep working.
users.delete_effect: Their API tokens and project memberships go too. Someone who owns projects or jobs cannot be deleted until those are deleted.
users.unrecorded: Fione does not record sign-ins, so there is no last sign-in time.
users.error.username: Enter a username of 1 to 64 characters.
users.error.username_invalid: Use only letters, digits, dot, hyphen and underscore.
users.error.password: The password needs at least {n} characters.
users.refused.last_admin: Fione needs at least one administrator: make someone else an administrator first.
users.refused.self_role: You cannot give up your own administrator role. Another administrator has to do it.
users.refused.self_delete: You cannot delete your own account. Another administrator has to do it.
users.refused.owns_projects: They own {n} project(s). Delete those projects first: an administrator can, from the Delete project button on each project's page.
users.refused.owns_jobs: They own {n} job(s). Delete those jobs first.
users.refused.conflict: The change is not possible right now.
system.title: System status
system.lead: How this Fione server is doing. It refreshes by itself.
system.disk_note: Free disk space is not reported here: check it on the server.
system.llm_text: An assistant that runs on your own server (Ollama) is planned. There is nothing to set up yet.
members.title: Sharing
members.lead: Who else may see or edit this project. Only the owner and administrators can change this.
members.done.removed: The member was removed. They no longer see the project.
members.username_hint: They need an account here; an administrator creates accounts.
members.access_hint: Sharing with someone who is already a member changes their access.
members.owner_note: The owner always has full access.
members.remove_effect: They no longer see the project. What they made stays.
members.levels: Can edit: upload data, train and predict. View only: look, without changing anything. A user whose role is Viewer can only look, whatever they are given here.
members.error.username: Enter a username of 1 to 64 characters.
members.error.access: Choose Can edit or View only.
members.error.owner: {username} owns the project and already has full access.
members.error.not_member: {username} is not a member of this project.
error.admin_only_hint: Ask an administrator if you need this.
users.refused.self_password: Change your own password on your account page: it asks for your current one.
project.delete_lead: Only the owner and administrators can do this.
project.delete_effect: Running and queued jobs are stopped first. Its datasets, models, jobs and predictions are deleted for good, and the people it is shared with lose access.
job.lead.explain: Fione is working out which inputs matter most to the model and how its predictions change with them. This page updates by itself.
job.stage.importance: Working out which inputs matter most…
job.stage.explaining: Drawing how the predictions change: {done} of {total} columns…
job.cancel_effect.explain: Explaining stops. The model keeps its earlier explanation, if it has one.
